svg.title: U.S. city average grocery price levels, January 2018 to May 2023
svg.desc: Three separate monthly price panels show white bread in dollars per pound, large eggs in dollars per dozen, and whole milk in dollars per gallon. The source is the June 13, 2023 ALFRED vintage. Units differ; prices are not directly comparable.
